about: Pieces a selection file can name: get-offline-library.sh --select <file> / Get-OfflineLibrary.ps1 -Selection <file> (#139). required: always installed. needs: other ids that must be in the same selection. gb: size in GB (1024^3 bytes) measured on a full drive, the numbers both installers' space estimate uses; null = sized at install time. CI (.github/scripts/check-catalog.sh) checks that both installers accept every id and use these numbers.

pieces.label: core (AI engine, 3B model, medical, survival, manuals, Kiwix, phone apps)
pieces.desc: Always included: the AI engine, a small 3B chat model, the medical and survival references, the Army manuals, the Kiwix reader and the phone apps.

pieces.label: GPT4All, iFixit, Appropedia
pieces.desc: The GPT4All desktop AI plus the iFixit repair archive and the Appropedia DIY archive.

pieces.label: 8B + 7B AI models
pieces.desc: The larger 8B and 7B chat models — smarter answers, more RAM and disk.

pieces.label: Wikipedia
pieces.desc: All of Wikipedia (no images) as a Kiwix archive — the single biggest piece.

pieces.label: OsmAnd maps for the selected regions + desktop viewer (map files are sized from the OsmAnd index)
pieces.desc: Offline OsmAnd maps for the regions you pick, with a desktop viewer. Map file sizes are measured at install time.

pieces.label: browser maps for the selected regions (US states)
pieces.desc: Street maps for the US states you picked, viewable in any web browser.

pieces.label: Khan Academy
pieces.desc: The full Khan Academy archive including all videos — very large (opt-in).

pieces.label: Kolibri learning app (content is picked in the app and not counted)
pieces.desc: The Kolibri learning app; you choose subjects inside the app, so its size is not counted here.

pieces.label: Wikivoyage + Wikibooks
pieces.desc: The Wikivoyage travel guide and Wikibooks open textbooks (Kiwix).

pieces.label: translator model
pieces.desc: An offline two-way text translator (a small multilingual model on the bundled AI engine).

pieces.label: MedlinePlus health topics
pieces.desc: Plain-language health-topic summaries from MedlinePlus (US NLM), as one offline page.
